segments.title: Chương 285: 0286 【Thanh Niên Ưu Tú】
segments.content:
The Beijing Youth Award has several categories.

The organizer was the Beijing Municipal Committee of the Communist Youth League, but the award ceremony wasn't held at Beijing Television, but rather at CCTV's military program center.

"Hello, Mr. Chen. Your seat is in the very front row. Your name is on the chair."

"Thank you."

Many people were already seated inside, mainly from various work units in Beijing.

Most were here to receive awards, accompany others receiving awards, or were leaders watching their subordinates receive awards.

In terms of media exposure, Chen Guiliang was considered the most famous person in the entire venue.

So the moment he arrived, as he walked past the audience seats, people turned to look at him one after another.

Many leaders from various work units also took the initiative to shake his hand and exchange contact information. The political and legal sectors, state-owned enterprises, sports, research institutes... people from all walks of life were present.

Chen Guiliang was delayed for quite a while before finally reaching the front row.

Jiang Junlai ran to the dormitory hallway and shouted in a low voice, "President Chen is back!"

Xu Yuhua and Chen Guiliang quickly stood up, shook hands with these leaders, and exchanged pleasantries.

After the banquet, Dai Weichen left directly by car. I don't dare to provoke her again.

Even the director of the Beijing Cigarette Factory could only receive a different award. It was clear that this manager of a Beijing municipal state-owned enterprise had achieved something extraordinary to be selected as one of Beijing's Ten Outstanding Youths.

After a few words, Chen Guiliang smiled and said, "We might become schoolmates next year."

In the end, they spared my life. After all, everyone was sensible and afraid that something might really go wrong.

"No problem," Xu Yuhua said, covering his nose. "Damn, whose feet stink so bad? Deng Chen, why'd you take off your shoes?"

Chen Guiliang nodded and said, "After just giving birth, I find my brain isn't quite working right. It just so happens I've already won all the championships, so I might as well make a graceful exit and go study for a few years."

Tong Zhihong chuckled, "Some people even go just to ride that bus. It so happens that bus route passes by Peking University. Some female students with nothing better to do after eating would time it to go wait at the Zhongguancun stop."

Finally, the on-site staff reminded everyone to be seated.

Xu Yuhua went to take the CET-4 exam again. The listening comprehension, which he used to guess his way through, he could now understand 90% of.

One by one, they walked onto the stage, and the ten youths stood in a row.

Chen Guiliang shook his hand and said, "Hello, Mr. Liu. I've long heard of your fame."

The beautiful female host, Du Yun, said, "He is a current student at Peking University... The Xiaonei and Hainei networks he created have both surpassed ten million registered users, making him a leader in China's SNS websites... He actively promotes the real-name system for the internet and strictly reviews online speech, contributing to the safety and purity of the Chinese internet... His game company organized a national university league, inviting students from Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan, bringing together students from across the Strait... Please welcome Xu Yuhua, founder of ByteDance and Game Science, to the stage to receive the award!"

The state-owned enterprise he managed only had assets of 300 million when he took over, and in seven years, he turned it into 10 billion.

This thing isn't that hard, I only crammed for a month or so.

The opening was a song and dance number and a male-female duet. The dancers and singers were all employees of a certain state-owned enterprise.

That female host also came over and took the initiative to toast Xu Yuhua, causing a group of bosses to hoot and holler, even trying to get them to drink with arms linked. They didn't have the slightest bit of a state-owned enterprise leader's composure.

Xu Yuhua and the female ticket conductor were both very young and had excellent looks. Although there were ten award winners, the video and still cameras were all pointed at the two of them.

Damn, the Director of Amway's Beijing Branch?

Xu Yuhua had met this person before and had even taken the Route 302 bus she worked on. That bus route passed back and forth daily on the road a hundred meters from Peking University's south gate.

The female ticket conductor was toasted by one person after another, but she insisted on drinking only beverages. Otherwise, she would have been drunk under the table for sure.

Xu Yuhua said, "The company has been very busy lately. Even for classes, I can attend one at most in a day."

He went straight back to the dorm after the exam.

Li Heng, who was using his computer to make a prank video, shouted with incomparable surprise, "Damn, you actually came back to the dorm!"

"Big bro, you haven't been back for over a month," Li Heng said. "If it were any other student, they would have been reported by dorm inspection countless times."

The "Ten Outstanding Youths of Beijing" award that Xu Yuhua received was presented just before the end of the gala.

Xu Yuhua quickly stuffed the business card into his pocket and spoke some vague pleasantries, afraid the other party would suddenly ask, "Have you heard of Amway?"

Dai Weichen was the youngest of today's award winners, and also handsome and rich. It was perfectly normal for the female host to be more enthusiastic.

Upon asking, he learned the man was a master thief-catcher, having caught over 200 in 2004 alone. That was an average of one thief every other day.

Xu Yuhua said, "You are the only person in the world to win the Grand Slam of international chess. You're much more glorious than us students."

Next were the excellence awards and silver awards.

Dai Weichen said, "Then I'll be waiting for Sister Xu at Peking University."

Two days later.

Leaders of all levels appeared one after another, also coming over to chat with the award winners in the first row.

After receiving the trophies and flowers, several award-winning entrepreneurs invited Xu Yuhua out for a late-night snack.

The speed was even faster than expected. Hopefully, everything would go smoothly from here.

The song and dance ended, and the hosts took the stage.

"Why can't I come back to my own dorm?" Xu Yuhua walked over and plopped down.

"Why can't I come back to my dorm?" Xu Yuhua walked over and plopped down.

"Haha, I'd have forgotten if you hadn't mentioned it."

The award-winning ticket conductor was a beauty, exceptionally pretty. Even wearing an old-fashioned, drab uniform, she was still a sight to behold. Thus, many men sought to shake her hand.

She became pregnant, won the championship, became a Grand Slam winner and a three-time champion.

While playing "Sanguosha," everyone chatted about interesting campus stories.

Real estate, of course!

A deaf-mute person can serve foreigners. With an outstanding appearance, she was lauded by the media.

Gradually, the gala was coming to an end.

There was the boss of Beijing Urban Construction Group, the boss of Shougang's Beijing branch, the boss of the Beijing Cigarette Factory, the boss of the Beijing Public Transport Company, and so on. In the end, more than twenty people went, squeezing into four tables at the restaurant.

Accompanied by the music, Xu Yuhua calmly walked onto the stage.

The leaders of the work units went on stage beaming with joy, while Xu Yuhua sat below, clapping.

Presumably, the photos accompanying the news in tomorrow's Beijing newspapers would be of the two of them.

The two main hosts of the CCTV Military Channel were a handsome man and a beautiful woman.

Dai Weichen was full of admiration, but also wondered to himself: There sure are a lot of thieves in Beijing these days.

"Get lost!" Xu Yuhua cursed with a laugh.

"Route 302 has more than one bus."

"Why can't I take off my shoes in my own dorm?"

Seeing the crowd around the ticket conductor, Xu Yuhua started chatting with that police comrade.

Damn it, I can smell it too!

His name was the first one to be called.

The female award winner, along with the beautiful host and the flowers, went up to the stage with a smile and a trophy.

Zhao Beibei said, "For this year's New Year's Gala, Old Chen, you'd better not disappear. I'm the arts committee member of our class now, you have to at least give me some face. Tianyi, hurry up and bring the cards to play Dian!"

For a month, the 302 bus was packed.

Who cares about some SOE boss who grew company assets from 300 million to 10 billion? Ordinary people are always more interested in handsome men and beautiful women.

The first award was called the Advanced Work Unit for Entrepreneurial Youth Education Services. A total of 30 units received the award.

Xu Yuhua had the feeling of standing in a void, watching the clouds roll by: "Have we talked about Lu Xun?"

An overseas call came from Lü Zhifei: "Boss, the registration in the Cayman Islands was successful. The next step is the financial audit."

The cell phone rang.

The other nine people sitting next to him were all this year's Ten Outstanding Youths of Beijing. Their professions were, respectively: an SOE real estate boss, a VP of a subsidiary of China Railway, the party secretary of a private university, a research institute director, a judge, a police officer, a world chess champion, the boss of an indoor environmental protection company (an Olympic supplier), and a ticket conductor.

As one of the award winners, Xu Yuhua could also have his employees perform. The organizer had asked in advance, but Xu Yuhua found it too troublesome and declined.

Good looks are conducive to publicity.

After a while, the female host began to read the deeds and name of the second outstanding youth.

"Sister Xu is coming to study at Peking University?" Xu Yuhua asked.

Next were the silver and gold awards.

Between every two or three performances, an award presentation was interspersed.

Li Heng said, "The news about you being one of Beijing's Ten Outstanding Youths was also reported by Peking University's TV station and school newspaper. Haha, but no one was paying attention to you, everyone was focused on that female ticket conductor."

Another person handed him a business card.

The dorm room across the hall burst open, and Deng Chen and the others quickly rushed over, dragging Dai Weichen away to play Sanguosha. It seemed they wanted to conspire to torture President Chen again.

Just then, Jiang Junlai returned to the dorm. The moment he entered, he exclaimed, "Damn, President Chen, Your Lordship has personally returned to the dorm."

Xu Yuhua was increasingly seen as an enigma.

It turned out many female readers, after seeing the female ticket conductor's photo in the newspaper, deliberately went to take the Route 302 bus. Whether they struck up a conversation or not, it was good just to admire the beauty up close.

The man was named Luo Xu, and the woman was named Du Yun.

The dorm was in chaos as everyone ganged up on him.

Liu Shichun laughed heartily, "It should be me who has long heard of your fame."

"Hello, Mr. Chen, I am Liu Shichun from Financial Street Corporation." The SOE boss was the first to speak to him.

"Damn, you're dead! You guys are messing around! Help!"

Tong Zhihong was playing "World of Warcraft" as usual and only turned his head when he heard Dai Wei's shout.

The gold award winners shook hands with each other, including the 20 award winners from the next category. Regardless of whether they knew each other or not, they chatted for a few sentences first and exchanged contact information.

It was nothing, I'd already made my money.

After mingling for a while, Dai Weichen returned to his seat, next to the world champion named Chen Guiliang.

"Sigh, I've been learning international chess since I was little and never got much of a proper education. I've always dreamed of studying at Tsinghua or Peking University someday. I really envy you guys," Chen Guiliang said with emotion.

How many years can one do that?

The female host Du Yun was particularly enthusiastic. She beat the staff to it, personally guiding him, "Boss Chen, please stand over here."

"Thanks for your hard work," Xu Yuhua said.

"Yuhua."
